paragraphs.text: Axelrod Gunnarson is a legendary Giant from Dominaria .

Axelrod Gunnarson is a legendary Giant from an unknown part of Dominaria that was introduced in Legends . He has a human-like appearance though standing several times larger than a tree. He wears cloth boots, and a white shirt, and has long dark hair that covers most of his face.
"Arms of Axelrod" was used by Gull as a form of curse in 4074 AR, indicating the giant lived before that time. His name was also invoked simply as "what in the name of Axelrod Gunnarson?"
